title: Why Your Game Screen Splits in Two
description:
That horizontal split is two rendered frames sharing one display refresh. This short animation shows how a fixed-refresh screen scans an image, how the GPU can replace that image mid-scan and why V-Sync and VRR solve the timing mismatch in different ways.

Sources:
https://developer.apple.com/documentation/quartzcore/cametallayer/displaysyncenabled
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/direct3ddxgi/variable-refresh-rate-displays
https://vesa.org/featured-articles/vesa-adds-adaptive-sync-to-popular-displayport-video-standard/

Visuals: original Pulse Gaming diagrams.
Narration: locally generated British synthetic voice.
Music: original Pulse Gaming synthesis.
